title: Double Glass Shelf 22-Inch Wall Mount W/ Gallery Rail Solid Brass | Autumn Sparkle | Waverly Place | Allied Brass
description:
Clear countertop clutter and keep everyday bath essentials organized and within reach with a space-saving wall-mounted glass shelf in Autumn Sparkle, which captures the rich, warm tones of fall foliage with subtle shimmer, bringing seasonal warmth year-round.

Highlights:
- Autumn Sparkle transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Count on strength in daily use—3/8-Inch thick tempered glass for safety and strength
- Coordinate a pulled-together look—part of the Waverly Place collection for matching Waverly Place, transitional bath accessories
- Enjoy enduring support—solid brass hardware with concealed screw mounting for a clean install

Specs & Installation:
- Shelf size: 22 x 5 Inches (each shelf)
- Overall dimensions: 22-Inch L x 5-Inch projection x 8-Inch H
- Glass thickness: 3/8-Inch (0.38 in), tempered
- Weight capacity: 4 lb
- Mounting type: wall mount; concealed screw mounting hardware
- Assembly: no assembly required
- Includes: glass shelf and all installation hardware (screws: #8 x 1 1/4")
- Style: transitional/traditional look suited to transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories
